crossRefs.note: “Haven’t you brought this on yourself, in that you have forsaken Yahweh your God, when he led you by the way?
Therefore the showers have been withheld and there has been no latter rain; yet you have had a prostitute’s forehead…
Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.
Yahweh will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.
Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not…
Why does a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion. He will no more carry you away into captivity. He…

translations.web: “Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.
translations.bsb: Your iniquities have diverted these from you; your sins have deprived you of My bounty.
translations.kjv: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good
translations.asv: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good from you.
